reason: A data-processing plugin that calculates configurable per-model token costs, flags peak-period calls, and exposes session and cross-session billing summaries through the UI and command interface.

summaries.zh: 按可配置的模型价格计算大语言模型调用成本，并在界面中提供会话及跨会话费用汇总。
summaries.en: Calculates LLM call costs from configurable per-model pricing and provides session and cross-session billing summaries in the interface.

capabilities: Calculates token costs using configured per-model pricing
Publishes per-session and cross-session cost projections for display
Persists billing data when a storage backend is configured
